fullName.value: Nuclear ubiquitous casein and cyclin-dependent kinase substrate 1

texts.value: Chromatin-associated protein involved in DNA repair by promoting homologous recombination (HR) (PubMed:26323318). Binds double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) and secondary DNA structures, such as D-loop structures, but with less affinity than RAD51AP1 (PubMed:26323318)
Widely expressed, with highest levels in thyroid gland, prostate and uterus and in fetal liver, thymus and lung
Phosphorylated in an ATM-dependent manner in response to DNA damage (PubMed:26323318). Phosphorylated by CDK1 and casein kinase (PubMed:11298763)
